title: Northeast PHP 2018 Boston - Call for Speakers
content:
The team at Northeast PHP is excited to annouce that we're returning to Boston, September 19-21 2018, and the is now open until April 11.Call for Speakers

We're pleased to announce our conference, , where community members come together to learn and share information about the latest trends and technologies in professional PHP development, User Experience design, and Web Technologies.the 2018 Web Development and UX Conference by Northeast PHP

Our community oriented conference wants to hear from you! Our speaker package includes a full conference ticket and hotel for out of town speakers. We're interested in talks about PHP secuity, internals, testing, and frameworks; Front End JavaScript development; Front End user experience design, accessibility, virtual and augmented reality, mobile design, information visualization; and soft topics including project management, agile, professional development, mental health, and human resources. First time speakers are welcome and encouraged.
